# Red-cell indices

## Microcytosis

Low mean corpuscular volume (MCV) describes microcytosis. MCV, mean corpuscular hemoglobin, hemoglobin, red-cell count, and red-cell distribution width are interpreted together rather than in isolation.

## Information used in evaluation

Iron studies including ferritin can provide relevant context when an iron-deficient pattern is considered. Hemoglobin analysis can provide relevant context when a hemoglobin trait is considered. These references do not establish a diagnosis for an individual patient.
